url <- "http://bkref.com/pi/shareit/6dL2P"

# Read the webpage
webpage <- read_html(url)

# Extract the HTML table(s)
tables <- html_nodes(webpage, "table")

# Assuming we want the first table on the page
twothousandnineseason <- html_table(tables[[1]], fill = TRUE)

# Convert to a data frame
twothousandnineseason <- as.data.frame(twothousandnineseason)

 # Use the second row as the new column names
colnames(twothousandnineseason) <- twothousandnineseason[1, ]

# Remove the first two rows (original headers and the new column names row)
twothousandnineseason <- twothousandnineseason[-c(1), ]
twothousandnineseason <- twothousandnineseason[-21,]

# Remove columns 22, 23, and 25
twothousandseason <- twothousandseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandoneseason <- twothousandoneseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandtwoseason <- twothousandtwoseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandthreeseason <- twothousandthreeseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandfourseason <- twothousandfourseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandfiveseason <- twothousandfiveseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandsixseason <- twothousandsixseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandsevenseason <- twothousandsevenseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandeightseason <- twothousandeightseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))
twothousandnineseason <- twothousandnineseason %>% select(-c(22, 23, 25))

# Create a list of data frames and their corresponding season names
season_list <- list(
  "2000" = twothousandseason,
  "2001" = twothousandoneseason,
  "2002" = twothousandtwoseason,
  "2003" = twothousandthreeseason,
  "2004" = twothousandfourseason,
  "2005" = twothousandfiveseason,
  "2006" = twothousandsixseason,
  "2007" = twothousandsevenseason,
  "2008" = twothousandeightseason,
  "2009" = twothousandnineseason
)

# Add a season column and combine all data frames without changing column names
nbaseasons <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(season_list), function(season) {
    df <- season_list[[season]]
    df$season <- season  # Add a column with the season name
    
    # Ensure column names are not altered
    colnames(df) <- make.names(colnames(df), unique = TRUE)
    
    return(df)
  })
)

#### Preliminary Analysis

```{r, results='asis', message=F, warning=F, comment=NA, echo=T}


#convert everything to numberic
nbaseasons <- nbaseasons %>%
  mutate(across(c(W, L, PW, PL, MOV, SOS, SRS, ORtg, DRtg, NRtg, Pace, FTr, `X3PAr`, `TS.`, `eFG.`, `TOV.`, `Attend.`, `Attend..G`, ORB., FT.FGA, DRB.), as.numeric))

# Post Hand Check
nbaseasons <- nbaseasons %>%
  mutate(post_rule = if_else(season >= 2005, 1, 0))


ggplot(nbaseasons, aes(x = season, y = ORtg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot of Offensive Rating Over Time", x = "Season", y = "Offensive Rating")

# Ensure that 'season' is numeric
nbaseasons$season <- as.numeric(nbaseasons$season)

# Plot with separate regression lines for before and after the rule change
ggplot(nbaseasons, aes(x = season, y = ORtg)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = as.factor(post_rule)), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(data = nbaseasons %>% filter(post_rule == 0), 
              aes(x = season, y = ORtg), 
              method = "lm", 
              se = FALSE, 
              color = "blue", 
              linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(data = nbaseasons %>% filter(post_rule == 1), 
              aes(x = season, y = ORtg), 
              method = "lm", 
              se = FALSE, 
              color = "red", 
              linetype = "solid") +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot of Offensive Rating Over Time with Regression Lines",
       x = "Season", y = "Offensive Rating") +
  theme_minimal()


ggplot(nbaseasons, aes(x = season, y = DRtg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot of Defensive Rating Over Time", x = "Season", y = "Defensive Rating")



# Check the number of observations by `post_rule`
nbaseasons %>% group_by(post_rule) %>% summarise(count = n())





      
# Convert the dataset to panel data format
pdata <- pdata.frame(nbaseasons, index = c("Team", "season"))




# Summary for post_rule == 0, excluding specified columns and filtering for specific teams
datasummary_skim(
  pdata %>% 
    filter(post_rule == 0, Team %in% c("Golden State Warriors", "Los Angeles Lakers", "Los Angeles Clippers", "Sacramento Kings", "Golden State Warriors*", "Los Angeles Lakers*", "Los Angeles Clippers*", "Sacramento Kings*")) %>%
    select(-`W`, -`L`, -`PW`, -`PL`, -`MOV`, -`SOS`, -`SRS`),
  title = "Panel Data (Before Rule Change)"
)

# Summary for post_rule == 1, excluding specified columns and filtering for specific teams
datasummary_skim(
  pdata %>% 
    filter(post_rule == 1, Team %in% c("Golden State Warriors", "Los Angeles Lakers", "Los Angeles Clippers", "Sacramento Kings", "Golden State Warriors*", "Los Angeles Lakers*", "Los Angeles Clippers*", "Sacramento Kings*")) %>%
    select(-`W`, -`L`, -`PW`, -`PL`, -`MOV`, -`SOS`, -`SRS`),
  title = "Panel Data (After Rule Change)"
)



```

#### Regression Analysis

```{r, results='asis', message=F, warning=F, comment=NA, echo=T}

      
# Run separate regressions for each variable on post_rule
model_ORTG <- plm(ORtg ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_DRTG <- plm(DRtg ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_pace <- plm(Pace ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_tov <- plm(TOV. ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_ftr <- plm(FTr ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_ts <- plm(TS. ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_efg <- plm(eFG. ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_ftfga <- plm(FT.FGA ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_3PA<- plm(X3PAr ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_ORB <- plm(ORB. ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")
model_DRB <- plm(DRB. ~ post_rule, data = pdata, model = "within")

# Create a list of models
models <- list("Offensive Rating" = model_ORTG, "Defensive Rating"= model_DRTG, "Free Throws per FG attempt"= model_ftfga,"Percentage of Three Pointers Attempted"= model_3PA, "Offensive Rebound Percentage" = model_ORB, "Defensive Rebound Percentage"= model_DRB, "Pace" = model_pace, "Turnover Percentage" = model_tov, "Free Throw Attempt Rate" = model_ftr, "Total Shot Percentage" = model_ts, "Effective Field Goal Percentage" = model_efg)

# Generate the summary table with customized settings
modelsummary(models,
             coef_map = c("post_rule" = "Post-Rule"),
             stars = TRUE,
             gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
             title = "Effects of Post-Rule on Metrics",
             output = "default")

  
```
